fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable ID for this occurrence (source + source event + start time).

fields.name: series_id
fields.description: Shared by every occurrence of the same program or tour.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Source ID (see /api/v1/sources.json).

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: Display name of the organization that lists the event.

fields.name: source_event_id
fields.description: The source's own ID or URL slug.

fields.name: also_listed
fields.description: Other calendars that list the same event: [{source, url, title}]. Each event appears once.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Event title as published.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Plain-text description.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: First ~220 characters of the description.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Event page on the source site.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Image URL from the source.

fields.name: start
fields.description: ISO 8601 start, in the event's local time zone (date only when all_day).

fields.name: end
fields.description: ISO 8601 end, same rules as start.

fields.name: all_day
fields.description: True when no start time is published.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: IANA time zone of the venue, e.g. America/Denver.

fields.name: attendance
fields.description: How people attend.

fields.name: online_url
fields.description: Livestream or online link, when published.

fields.name: cost
fields.description: Whether attending costs money.

fields.name: cost_note
fields.description: Wording such as 'Included with admission' or 'Timed-entry pass required'.

fields.name: price_min
fields.description: Lowest listed price in USD.

fields.name: price_max
fields.description: Highest listed price in USD.

fields.name: registration_required
fields.description: True when the source says registration or tickets are required.

fields.name: registration_url
fields.description: Where to register or buy tickets.

fields.name: venue
fields.description: {name, address, city, region, postal_code, country, lat, lon}.

fields.name: organizer
fields.description: Organizing body (park unit, museum department, etc.).

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Type of listing.

fields.name: categories
fields.description: Source categories or program types.

fields.name: audiences
fields.description: Audience labels from the source (e.g. All Ages).

fields.name: recurring
fields.description: True for repeating tours and programs (one record per occurrence).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Listing status.

fields.name: accessibility
fields.description: Accessibility note from the source.

fields.name: region_label
fields.description: Short place label for display, e.g. 'Dickinson, ND'.

fields.name: area
fields.description: In town, a drive out of Medora, or online.

fields.name: area_label
fields.description: 'In Medora', 'Out of Medora' or 'Online'.

fields.name: drive_minutes
fields.description: Approximate one-way drive time from Medora in minutes (estimate; 0 in town).

fields.name: drive_label
fields.description: Display text, e.g. 'About 35 min from Medora'.

fields.name: lat
fields.description: Map latitude (WGS84). Null for online events or places that couldn't be located.

fields.name: lon
fields.description: Map longitude (WGS84).

fields.name: geo_precision
fields.description: 'venue' when the pin is the venue itself; 'town' when it is the town center (approximate).

fields.name: first_seen
fields.description: Date this calendar first picked up the event.

fields.name: last_seen
fields.description: Date of the most recent run that still found it.

fields.name: extra
fields.description: Source-specific fields (park code, room, capacity, presenter, ...).
